title: H5: policy-refused commit leaves the epoch open; codes
description: protocol-06 §5.3. A commit that is MLS-valid but refused by room policy does not consume the epoch (the next valid and allowed commit wins: 'first valid commit per epoch in hub order; policy afterwards'). A commit missing pending proposals, or with an invalid/partial GroupInfo, gets notAllowed with an errorDescription (not invalidProposal). Chosen (plan recommendation approved by Mark 2026-10-18).
